records.Name: Coral Reef Snorkeling Tour
records.Description__c: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with tropical fish just off Palonia's coastline.

records.Name: Whale Watching Voyage
records.Description__c: Sail into open waters to spot humpback and blue whales in their natural habitat.

records.Name: Beginner Surf Lesson
records.Description__c: Learn to ride the waves with our certified surf instructors on the resort's gentle north shore break.

records.Name: Sunrise Paddleboard Tour
records.Description__c: Glide across Palonia's calm lagoon and watch the sunrise paint the sky from the water.

records.Name: Sunset Sail
records.Description__c: Cast off at golden hour for a leisurely sail, live music, and champagne on the horizon.

records.Name: Coastal Eco Walk
records.Description__c: Discover hidden tide pools, mangroves, and coastal wildlife on a guided nature walk.

records.Name: Ocean Breeze Spa Retreat
records.Description__c: Surrender to total relaxation with deep-tissue massage and aromatherapy ocean-view treatments.

records.Name: Beach Yoga at Sunrise
records.Description__c: Begin your morning grounded — gentle sun salutations on soft sand as the sun crests the horizon.
